'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Jubaland crisis]]
***At least ten people are killed after [[Jubaland Dervish Force|Jubaland forces]] claim they have taken full control of the [[Beled Hawo District]] headquarters as well as the entire city, following heavy fighting with the [[Somali National Army]] from the [[Federal Government of Somalia]]. **[[Flash flood]]ing kills three people and leaves 15 others missing in [[Gilgit-Baltistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-monsoon-rains-flash-floods-landslides-tourists-acccf52a08255a4502cea64be99d9cb3 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[Japan–United States relations]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a trade deal with [[Japan]] on [[Truth Social]] that would let Japan invest $550 billion into the [[United States]] and reduce the [[tariff]]s to 15%. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2025/07/23/trump-announces-massive-trade-deal-with-japan-with-15percent-tariffs.html (CNBC)]
**[[Philippines–United States relations]]
***President Trump announces a [[trade agreement]] with [[President of the Philippines|Philippine president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] that sets a 19% tariff on Philippine exports to the United States, while U.S. goods entering the [[Philippines]] will be exempt from tariffs. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/07/22/business/trump-philippines-trade-deal (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-pay-19-tariff-trump-says-2025-07-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 anti-corruption protests in Ukraine|2025 Ukrainian protests]], [[Corruption in Ukraine]]
**The [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Verkhovna Rada|parliament]] adopts a law placing the [[National Anti-Corruption Bureau]] and the [[Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office]] under the [[Prosecutor General of Ukraine|Prosecutor General]], sparking widespread protests across the country, the largest since the 2022 Russian invasion. Despite calls to veto the law, [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] signs the law. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/07/22/world/europe/zelensky-protests-corruption.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://kyivindependent.com/veto-the-law-wartime-protests-sweep-ukraine-after-parliament-passes-bill-weakening-anti-corruption-institutions/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
